content.user_title: Review Data Rights and Compliance Risks
content.value_statement: Data transactions can fail when ownership, source authority, and compliance evidence are unclear. This skill structures a due diligence review and prepares draft findings for qualified legal review.
actual_capabilities: Creates a data-rights due diligence checklist for entity, source, ownership, compliance, and security evidence.
Maps data sources to authorization-chain questions and use restrictions.
Structures a draft legal review using positive, conditional, reserved, or negative conclusions.
Reviews data transaction contracts against twelve listed clause areas.
Identifies common personal information, important-data, intellectual-property, contract, and cross-border risks.
Produces a materials request list and risk register for human legal review.
limitations: It does not provide legal advice or create a legally valid legal opinion.
A qualified lawyer or law firm must review, sign, and issue any formal opinion.
It cannot verify facts, licenses, regulatory filings, or evidence authenticity without reliable source materials.
The knowledge base is China-focused and may not reflect current local or foreign law.

use_cases.title: Prepare a registration evidence request
use_cases.description: Create a document checklist for a data-rights registration project before engaging external counsel.

use_cases.title: Assess a proposed data acquisition
use_cases.description: Organize source, authorization, personal information, and resale risks for a planned dataset purchase.

use_cases.title: Review a data transaction contract
use_cases.description: Identify missing rights, usage restrictions, security, acceptance, and termination terms in a contract draft.

prompt_templates.title: Build a basic checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a simple evidence checklist for reviewing ownership and lawful source of a business dataset. Mark each item as required or optional.

prompt_templates.title: Review source authority
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this data-source summary. List the authorization-chain gaps, intended-use limits, and evidence I should request: [paste summary].

prompt_templates.title: Assess a transaction contract
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this data transaction contract against the twelve clause areas in the skill. Produce a prioritized risk register with missing terms and review questions: [paste contract].

prompt_templates.title: Draft a qualified review outline
prompt_templates.prompt: Using these verified materials, draft a non-binding legal review outline. State assumptions, evidence gaps, jurisdiction, and conditional conclusions. Do not present it as a signed legal opinion: [paste materials].

output_examples.input: We acquired customer analytics data through a reseller and plan to use it for marketing.
output: Key risk: confirm the reseller had authority to transfer the data and permit marketing use.
Evidence needed: upstream contract, consent records, data categories, retention period, and transfer restrictions.
Draft conclusion: reserve conclusion until the authorization chain and personal information basis are verified.

output_examples.input: Review our data supply agreement before a commercial launch.
output: High priority: define the dataset, permitted purposes, and whether onward transfer is prohibited.
Add acceptance criteria, security duties, breach handling, and termination-time return or deletion obligations.
Escalate personal information, important data, and cross-border transfer questions to qualified counsel.

best_practices: Provide verified source documents and identify the intended data use, jurisdiction, and recipient.
Treat every conclusion as a draft until a qualified lawyer reviews the evidence and applicable law.
Record assumptions, evidence gaps, and material changes in the final review package.
anti_patterns: Do not present AI-generated text as a signed legal opinion or regulatory filing.
Do not infer ownership or consent from incomplete contracts or informal statements.
Do not use a general checklist as a substitute for sector-specific or cross-border legal review.

faq.question: Can this skill issue a legal opinion?
faq.answer: No. It can prepare a draft review, but a qualified lawyer or law firm must review, sign, and issue any legal opinion.

faq.question: Which legal area does it cover?
faq.answer: It focuses on data ownership, source authority, data compliance, transaction contracts, and related China-focused legal considerations.

faq.question: What materials should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide entity records, data inventories, source and authorization documents, contracts, compliance records, and intended-use details.

faq.question: Can it verify data ownership?
faq.answer: No. It can identify evidence and questions, but it cannot independently verify facts, records, or third-party rights.

faq.question: Can it review personal information risks?
faq.answer: Yes. It can organize review questions about notice, consent, minimization, de-identification, and transfer restrictions. Human counsel must validate conclusions.

faq.question: Is the output valid outside China?
faq.answer: Not necessarily. The reference material is China-focused. Obtain advice from counsel qualified in the relevant jurisdiction.
